problem_type: CommonJS host importing private Pi NodeNext island
symptom: The agent-runtime-wiring gate detects that electron/ai/agentChatV2.ts directly imports a Pi island .mjs module, pulling the island into the CommonJS host graph.
direct_cause: The host imports the Pi implementation path instead of consuming a host-safe boundary for skill-index construction.
class_root: The CommonJS Electron host and strict NodeNext Pi runtime must have an explicit one-way boundary; host modules cannot import private Pi island implementation paths.
affected_population: Electron host builds and dev compilation
Agent chat turns that construct the skill catalog
internal_only_reason: The host/island direction is an internal build and runtime boundary; the installed Pi dependency is not the defect.
invariants: The CommonJS host source graph contains no import of electron/harness/runtime/pi implementation modules.
Pi runtime files remain compiled only by electron/tsconfig.pi.json and retain their strict NodeNext checks.
generality_proof: The static wiring gate checks the complete host program and the Pi include boundary; moving the host consumer behind a non-Pi module prevents this class for all future host imports while leaving Pi's own internal imports intact.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Build the host prompt from a host-safe skill catalog boundary without importing Pi implementation code.

shared_boundaries.symbol: private pi build and test wiring
shared_boundaries.responsibility: Fail closed when the host program includes private Pi island modules.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: This is the failing host consumer and is covered by the static program graph assertion.
This module is inside the declared Pi include and its relative .mjs import is valid within the NodeNext island.

recurrence.reason: Any future host module can accidentally import the Pi island and break the same compile/package boundary.
same_class_scan: Checked agentChatV2.ts as the host consumer and resources.mts as an in-island consumer.

prevention.invariant: The CommonJS host's parsed program must contain zero Pi island source files.
prevention.failure_mode: The wiring test fails before build delivery when a host import crosses into the island.
prevention.strategy: Keep the host consumer on a host-safe boundary and retain the strict graph assertion as a structural guard.

legacy_paths.rationale: The Pi implementation remains active for the private runtime; only the illegal host import edge is removed.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pi 0.84.3 is the verified pinned runtime for M1; retain it while the application boundary prevents host leakage.
dependency_lifecycle.target: A future verified Pi upgrade evaluated against the same NodeNext island and native suites
exit_criteria: Re-run the native agent-runtime suites and host graph gate for the candidate version.
Update the pinned dependency graph only after packaging and typecheck evidence passes.

migration: No runtime data migration is needed; the host import edge changes at compile time and Pi remains the active runtime implementation.
residual_risks: Future host consumers must use the host-safe catalog boundary and remain covered by the graph gate.
